scope: Actual pinned IRQ0 dispatcher and HAL helpers entered through source-owned vector word; exact MMIO/callback/state order, duplicate-HF suppression, calibration completion, mutable later events/callback pointer and repeated invocation
limitations: Actual legacy clock callback and notification bodies execute; application notification callbacks are fixtures, registers are emulated.
Direct vector calls prove slot binding and callable ABI, not actual Cortex-M exception entry/return, priorities, nesting or physical interrupts.
Remaining vectors, complete startup, calibration analog timing, image linking and byte equality remain unproven.
